svg.text: Sec. 8.1 | Execution Substrate, Telemetry, and Replay
Isolated tool sandbox and trace logging
Immutable traces preserve experimental evidence for reproducible auditing
Sec. 8.2 | Human Specification and Algorithmic Scaling
Qualitative expertise grounds risk taxonomies and resolves boundary ambiguity
Batch screening routes edge cases to experts
Risk Register and Evaluation Standards Refinement
Adjudicated boundary cases update risk registers and escalation thresholds
STAR, Alvarado Garcia et al., Going PLACES
Expert adjudication isolates novel harms, driving continuous rubric evolution
Sec. 8.3 | Balancing Transparency and Downstream Exploitability
Tier 1 (Public): Open benchmark suites and leaderboards (HarmBench)
Tier 2 (Gated): Controlled access for vetted researchers (Fang et al.)
Tier 3 (Withheld): Exploits withheld; system cards published (OpenAI)
Artifact access is tiered by dual-use risk and downstream exploitability
Standardized dimensions enable verifiable cross-party security auditing
Coordinated disclosure pipeline validates mitigations prior to advisory
